_comment: Public claims contract (spec pose-public-claims-contract). Surfaces are declared, never discovered: a scanner that flagged every version-shaped string would fail on changelogs, historical assessments and release notes, which are supposed to name old versions. Only what a surface claims about the CURRENT product is checked. Verified by `pose public-claims --strict`.

product.name: POSE
product.category: open-source Spec-Driven Development framework for governed agentic software delivery

surfaces.note: The verified-install block pins an exact version on purpose; POSE publishes no moving v1 tag. Every other version mention was removed.
Mirrors README.md. It previously pinned 1.4.3 in the same block, instructing readers to install a release four minors behind.
The docs home describes the current architecture and must not be pinned to a minor.
